# Cisco
> Cisco is a global technology company providing networking, security, collaboration, observability, and infrastructure solutions for enterprises and service providers.

Cisco offers product documentation, software downloads, APIs, training, support resources, and solution guidance across networking, security, cloud, data center, and AI infrastructure.

## Products and Services
- [Products and Services](https://www.cisco.com/site/us/en/products/index.html): Main catalog of Cisco hardware, software, and cloud offerings.
- [Networking](https://www.cisco.com/site/us/en/products/networking/index.html): Portfolio of enterprise, campus, branch, and service provider networking products.
- [Security](https://www.cisco.com/site/us/en/products/security/index.html): Security products for zero trust, firewall, XDR, identity, and cloud protection.
- [Collaboration](https://www.cisco.com/site/us/en/products/collaboration/index.html): Collaboration tools including calling, meetings, messaging, and contact center solutions.
- [Compute and Hyperconverged](https://www.cisco.com/site/us/en/products/compute-hyperconverged/index.html): UCS servers and hyperconverged infrastructure for data center workloads.
- [Data Center Networking](https://www.cisco.com/site/us/en/products/data-center-networking/index.html): Switching, fabrics, and automation for modern data center networks.
- [Observability](https://www.cisco.com/site/us/en/products/observability/index.html): Full-stack observability and application performance monitoring offerings.
- [Software](https://www.cisco.com/site/us/en/products/software/index.html): Cisco software subscriptions, platforms, and lifecycle management resources.

## Solutions
- [Solutions](https://www.cisco.com/site/us/en/solutions/index.html): Cisco solution guidance by business outcome, industry, and architecture.
- [AI Solutions](https://www.cisco.com/site/us/en/solutions/artificial-intelligence/index.html): Infrastructure and networking solutions designed for AI-ready environments.
- [Hybrid Work](https://www.cisco.com/site/us/en/solutions/hybrid-work/index.html): Solutions for secure collaboration and distributed workforce connectivity.
- [Cloud](https://www.cisco.com/site/us/en/solutions/cloud/index.html): Architectures and services for multicloud networking, security, and operations.
- [Data Center and Networking](https://www.cisco.com/site/us/en/solutions/data-center-virtualization/index.html): Solutions for data center modernization, automation, and workload connectivity.
- [Small Business](https://www.cisco.com/site/us/en/solutions/small-business/index.html): Networking, security, and collaboration solutions for small organizations.
- [Service Providers](https://www.cisco.com/site/us/en/solutions/service-provider/index.html): Infrastructure and automation solutions for telecom and service provider networks.
- [Industries](https://www.cisco.com/site/us/en/solutions/industries/index.html): Industry-specific solution pages for public sector, healthcare, finance, retail, and more.

## Support and Downloads
- [Support](https://www.cisco.com/site/us/en/support/index.html): Central support hub for product assistance, tools, and technical resources.
- [Downloads Home](https://software.cisco.com/download/home): Software download portal for Cisco operating systems, firmware, and tools.
- [All Products Support](https://www.cisco.com/site/us/en/support/all-products.html): Browse support resources by Cisco product family.
- [Technical Assistance Center](https://www.cisco.com/site/us/en/support/web/tsd-cisco-worldwide-contacts.html): Cisco TAC contact information and regional support access.
- [Support Case Manager](https://mycase.cloudapps.cisco.com/case): Open and manage Cisco support cases online.
- [End-of-Life and End-of-Sale Notices](https://www.cisco.com/c/en/us/products/eos-eol-listing.html): Official lifecycle notices for discontinued Cisco products.
- [Cisco Bug Search Tool](https://bst.cloudapps.cisco.com/bugsearch/): Search known software defects and bug details.
- [Serial Number Validation](https://snvui.cisco.com/snv/FNui/validate): Validate Cisco product serial numbers and coverage status.

## Documentation
- [Technical Documentation](https://www.cisco.com/c/en/us/support/index.html): Entry point for Cisco product documentation and technical support content.
- [Cisco Feature Navigator](https://cfnng.cisco.com/): Compare software features and platform support across Cisco releases.
- [Command Lookup Tool](https://www.cisco.com/c/en/us/support/web/tools-catalog/command-lookup-tool.html): Search Cisco CLI commands and related documentation.
- [Configuration Guides](https://www.cisco.com/c/en/us/support/docs/configuration-guides/index.html): Product configuration guides and deployment documentation.
- [Command References](https://www.cisco.com/c/en/us/support/docs/command-reference/index.html): Command reference manuals for Cisco platforms and software.
- [Release Notes](https://www.cisco.com/c/en/us/support/docs/release-notes/index.html): Release notes covering features, caveats, and resolved issues.
- [Compatibility Matrix](https://www.cisco.com/c/en/us/support/web/tools-catalog/compatibility-matrix.html): Check interoperability and supported software or hardware combinations.

## APIs and Developer Resources
- [Cisco DevNet](https://developer.cisco.com/): Developer portal for APIs, SDKs, sandboxes, and automation learning.
- [DevNet Learning Labs](https://developer.cisco.com/learning/): Hands-on labs and guided learning for Cisco platforms and APIs.
- [DevNet Sandboxes](https://developer.cisco.com/site/sandbox/): Reservable and always-on environments for testing Cisco technologies.
- [APIs](https://developer.cisco.com/docs/): Documentation for Cisco platform APIs and developer tools.
- [Code Exchange](https://developer.cisco.com/codeexchange/): Community code samples, integrations, and automation examples.
- [Meraki Developer Hub](https://developer.cisco.com/meraki/): APIs, webhooks, and developer resources for Cisco Meraki.
- [Webex for Developers](https://developer.webex.com/): APIs and SDKs for Webex messaging, meetings, calling, and integrations.
- [Cisco Intersight API Docs](https://intersight.com/apidocs): API reference for Cisco Intersight infrastructure management.

## Learning and Training
- [Learn](https://www.cisco.com/site/us/en/learn/index.html): Cisco learning hub for training, certifications, and educational resources.
- [Cisco U.](https://u.cisco.com/): Digital learning platform for Cisco technologies and certification preparation.
- [Cisco Certifications](https://www.cisco.com/site/us/en/learn/training-certifications/certifications.html): Overview of Cisco certification tracks and credentials.
- [Learning Network](https://learningnetwork.cisco.com/): Community and study resources for Cisco exams and technical learning.
- [Training and Events](https://www.cisco.com/site/us/en/learn/training-events/index.html): Cisco training offerings, webinars, and event listings.
- [Networking Academy](https://www.netacad.com/): Cisco education program for networking, cybersecurity, and IT skills.
- [Digital Learning](https://www.cisco.com/site/us/en/learn/digital-learning/index.html): On-demand courses and subscription-based Cisco training resources.

## Partners
- [Partners](https://www.cisco.com/site/us/en/partners/index.html): Partner programs, tools, and resources for Cisco ecosystem members.
- [Partner Program](https://www.cisco.com/site/us/en/partners/program.html): Information on Cisco partner program structure and benefits.
- [Partner Locator](https://locatr.cloudapps.cisco.com/WWChannels/LOCATR/openBasicSearch.do): Find Cisco partners by location, specialization, and services.
- [Partner Self-Service](https://www.cisco.com/c/en/us/partners/tools/self-service.html): Operational tools and self-service resources for partners.
- [Channel Partner Portal](https://www.cisco.com/c/en/us/partners/tools/partner-portal.html): Access point for partner sales, marketing, and support tools.
- [Marketplace](https://marketplace.cisco.com/): Cisco marketplace for partner and ecosystem solutions.
